2.88.32
Chart.Left
The Chart.Left element specifies the distance of a Chart from the left of the chart's container, such
as a Rectangle or Body. The Chart.Left element is optional. If this element is present, its value MUST
be a non-negative RdlSize. If this element is not present, its value is interpreted as 0.
Following is the parent element of the Chart.Left element.
Parent elements
Chart
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Chart.Left element.
 <xsd:element name="Left" type="SizeType" minOccurs="0" />
